text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both gaining ground with moderate conviction—BTC up 1.8% and ETH outpacing it at 2.7%—while altcoins track in line, suggesting broad-based strength rather than rotation. The Fear & Greed index at 73 and rising sharply over the past week points to growing confidence, though BTC dominance holding steady at 59% indicates investors aren't abandoning larger alts for Bitcoin alone. Volume at $88B is solid but not extreme, consistent with a measured rally rather than panic buying or capitulation.
